root_cause: The Netlify build regenerates index.html from the pinned compressed V18 payload in tools/bouw-v18-production-core.mjs before projecting the site-wide shell. Repository footer edits were therefore overwritten during production build.
prevention_rule: Footer requirements must be encoded in both the canonical footer component and the pinned V18 production builder that regenerates the homepage before shell projection.

evidence.outcome: Production readback after the previous deploy showed the four requested links absent. This candidate injects them in the actual V18 production builder and mirrors the same contract in the canonical footer component.
